entities.title: Escape pod
entities.summary: The launch, the 97 ticks watching the hull drift, and the rescue or death in the Deep.
entities.purpose: Launches the pod (RULES B.17, C.10.5, D.3.9), drifts the abandoned hull, and afterwards docks the rescued pilot at the station or, in the Deep, starts the death sequence.
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
The hull never collides with the player (deliberate difference 7).
